name: eoc::AiGrid::UpdateTileObjectFlags
evidence: write watch on an AI grid tile's AiFlags (TestLevel_Tom, tile 34,81): a barrel created on it (GK.Cheat.Spawn) - hits at +0xE3353B in frames 103, 104, 106 writing the bits 0x180 (WalkBlockItem, ShootBlockItem, as GetTileDebugInfo read after); on the door's tile at Osi.Open, frames 0 and 33; return chain FUN_140e38ae0 (add to tile) < FUN_140fc53f0 < eoc::AiGrid::ForEachBoxCell < eoc::BoundComponent::ForEachCell < FUN_140fc1cc0 (called by eoc::BoundComponent::Increase); decomp code read
does: Rebuilds the object part of one tile's flags from the bound objects listed in the tile's metadata: the flags of all of them are taken off, then those of the objects whose height reaches the tile's floor band are put back.

name: eoc::AiGrid::AddObjectToTile
evidence: the caller of eoc::AiGrid::UpdateTileObjectFlags in every hit of the write watch on a tile's flags when a barrel was created and when a placed door was opened or closed (TestLevel_Tom); its own caller FUN_140fc53f0 runs per cell of eoc::AiGrid::ForEachBoxCell; decomp code read: it finds the tile as RemoveObjectFromTile does
does: Puts one bound object on one tile of the AI grid: finds or makes the tile's metadata, adds the object to it, counts it on the subgrid, then rebuilds the tile's object flags.

name: eoc::AiGrid::RemoveObjectFromTile
evidence: write watch (GK.Memory.Watch, 8 bytes) on the AiFlags of an AI grid tile in TestLevel_Tom (tile 38,84 under a placed door; tile 34,81 under a created barrel), the tile reached from Bound+0x18 -> AiGrid -> Subgrids (+0x68) -> AiSubgrid.TileGrid (+0x30): hit at +0xE38E62 on Osi.Open of the door (the bits 0x100 and 0xC00000 - ShootBlockItem, Door, DoorItemBlock - cleared, read back by Ext.Level.GetTileDebugInfo) and on each refresh after a barrel's creation; return chain eoc::BoundComponent::Decrease < eoc::AiGrid::RemoveObject < esv::Item::UpdateBoundFlags; decomp code read
does: Takes one bound object off one tile of the AI grid: finds the subgrid by the tile's id, clears the object's grid flags from the tile and drops the object from the tile's metadata.

name: eoc::CopyStatsRollResult
evidence: GK.Memory.Watch on a passive check's RequestedRollComponent Result.Total (+0xC8) and Result.NaturalRoll (+0xCC): written 18 at +0xE75F73 and 15 at +0xE75F7F, from +0xF1889D
does: Copies a roll's result (total, natural die, discarded die, critical, threshold and the dice counts) into another.

name: eoc::CopyRollAndResult
evidence: the return chain of the Result writes at +0xE75F73/+0xE75F7F passes +0xF1889D; called from esv::RollSystem::RollDice (+0x32961CE) with the request's Roll (+0xA8)
does: Copies a roll record: the roll's definition and flags, then its result (through CopyStatsRollResult) and its metadata.

name: esv::roll::stream::DrawNumber
evidence: GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's stream count over one passive check: two hits at +0x105AAE3 (26 to 27, 27 to 28), one per die of the d20 pair
does: Draws one number from a roll stream: seats the generator at the stream's count, adds one to the count, returns the minimum plus the value modulo the range.

name: esv::roll::stream::ApplyRollResultBoosts
evidence: With MinimumRollResult and MaximumRollResult (SkillCheck,20) on the host, GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's count saw both draws run (0 to 1, 1 to 2) and the check came 20/20 instead of the stream's 9/11 at count 0; this is the only function called on each drawn die between the draw and the keeping of one (read in +0x105CCA0). A read watch on the boost's Result closed the game twice, so no read hit backs it. Independently: GK.Memory.Freeze of the Result (+0x1) of the host's attack pin's two boosts from 19 to 2 made the next fair melee attack miss plainly where 19 hit, and the function reads exactly those two components
does: Takes one drawn die and the roll type; for every MaximumRollResult boost of that type on the roller lowers the die to its Result, for every MinimumRollResult boost raises it to its Result. A boost of an umbrella roll type covers the rolls under it.

name: esv::roll::stream::RollOnStream
evidence: GK.Memory.Watch on the roll stream counts: both d20 draws of a fair melee attack return through +0x105B9ED of this function, called from RollAttackAgainstArmourClass (+0x106CE8B); it scans the manager's streams (0x78 bytes each, the layout the rolls executor confirmed) for the one asked; callers include eoc::stats::AbilityCheck (+0x10764A0) and the check against a DC at +0x1075BA0
does: Rolls on the roll manager's stream the caller names: finds it among the manager's streams, marks the manager changed, rolls through the weighted (Karmic Dice) path when weighted rolls are on and the stream's type is one it weights, else through RollDiceWithBoosts; answers the roll result.

name: esv::roll::stream::RollDice
evidence: Every hit of the draw (GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's count, +0x105AAE3) returns through +0x105CB3D; one passive check moves the count by two
does: Rolls a dice formula from a roll stream: seeds a 64-bit Mersenne Twister with the stream's seed, draws each die from 1 to its faces at the stream's count, adds the formula's bonus, and moves the stream's success or failure debt by the outcome against a difficulty.

name: esv::roll::stream::RollDiceWithBoosts
evidence: The draw's hits return through +0x105CDA1 into +0x105CB3D; one d20 check draws two dice (the count moves by two, tests/rolls/advantage/two_dice shows both dice); with the pin at 20 the draw still ran twice and the dice came 20/20
does: Rolls a d20 formula with its dice doubled, puts each die through the roller's minimum and maximum roll boosts, then with advantage or disadvantage alone keeps the higher or the lower of each pair, and with both or neither one of the pair. The bounded value is written over the drawn one in place.

name: esv::roll::stream::CopyStreams
evidence: GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's stream count (+0x14): every frame 1->0 at +0x105D919 and 0->1 at +0x105D967 from SystemUpdate<UpdateSystem> (+0x238ABC3); its only callee per stream is CopyStream (+0x105DB40); SaveStreams calls it with the manager's streams
does: Copies a whole array of roll streams into another: clears the target, then copies each stream into it.

name: esv::roll::stream::CopyStream
evidence: GK.Memory.Watch on the Generic stream's NumRolls (component and roll manager, stream+0x70): hits at +0x105DBBD every frame with the value unchanged, from SystemUpdate<esv::roll::stream::UpdateSystem> (+0x238ABC3) and from the SaveSystem's work (+0x342DDF9); the offsets it copies agree with Script Extender's Stream and PRNGState
does: Copies one roll stream (0x78 bytes) field by field into another: its combat participants, cast and player names, combat guid, type, frame, both debts, seed and count.

name: DecideAttackHit
evidence: Called by RollAttackAgainstArmourClass (+0x106CA40, on the watched return chain of the attack's d20 draws) right after the roll, with the armour class and the roll result; its rule matched three fair melee attacks read in HitDesc.ConditionRolls: total 5 against 13 a miss, 20 against 13 a hit, 20 against 21 (the goblin's Resistances.AC held at 21 by GK.Memory.Freeze) a miss
does: Decides whether an attack roll hits: applies the critical overrides gathered from the attacker's and target's boosts and conditions (forced critical hit or miss, critical hit or miss cancelled; the distance and the creatures' heights enter), then answers a miss for a natural 1 and for a total below the armour class without a natural 20, otherwise a hit.

name: RollAttackAgainstArmourClass
evidence: GK.Memory.Watch on the host's PlayerSpell roll stream NumRolls (roll manager, Element(+0x8, 1, 0x78, 0x70)) over fair melee attacks pinned at 2 and 15: both d20 draws (+0x105AAE3) return through +0x106CE8B of this function; the hit's HitDesc.ConditionRolls[1] read MeleeWeaponAttack, Difficulty 13 = the goblin's Resistances.AC, NaturalRoll 15, Total 20, flags Hit; with GK.Memory.Freeze of the goblin's eoc::ResistancesComponent.AC at 21 the same pinned 15 missed (Dodge|Miss) and Difficulty read 21
does: The attack roll of one attacker against one target: takes the target's armour class from eoc::ResistancesComponent.AC, rolls the d20 on the roll manager's stream, lets a GuaranteedChanceRollOutcome boost or the target's DodgeAttackRoll boost replace the result, has the hit decided against the armour class, writes the outcome into the hit's EffectFlags (Hit; Dodge and Miss; Critical; AttackAdvantage or AttackDisadvantage) and appends the roll and the armour class to the hit's ConditionRolls. Answers whether it hit.

name: RollDamageDice
evidence: GK.Memory.Watch on the host's PlayerDamage roll stream NumRolls: in a fair melee hit for 4 (dagger 1d4 pinned at 1, + 3) two draws (+0x105AAE3) in the frame of the damage, both returning through +0x10713AF of this function into +0x36E9347 (+0x36E8A80), one from stats::DealDamageFunctor::ApplyDamage (+0x36EA93B), one from +0x36EBCB0 (+0x36EC3FC); in a miss one draw, through +0x36EBCB0 only
does: Rolls a damage formula's dice on the damage roll stream through RollDiceWithBoosts, so that the damage pin bounds each die; called by the deal-damage functor's path and by the AI's scoring of stats functors.

name: ecl::InputController::UpdatePreview
evidence: client write watch (raw Ext.Debug.WatchWrite, 1 byte) on the preview task's TaskInfo.Succeeded (ecl::CharacterTask_Spell + 0x8 + 0x15, reached ClientCharacterComponent.InputController -> +0x58 PreviewTask), TestLevel_Tom, Fire Bolt aimed at a goblin in sight (taken) then behind the wall (refused 'path blocked'): 238 hits over 54 frames, every return chain through +0x1B40850 between ecl::InputController::Update and ecl::CharacterTask_Spell::UpdatePreview; decomp code read: it calls ecl::InputController::ChoosePreviewTask and SetPreviewTask, then updates the task
does: The input controller's per-frame step for the action under the pointer: chooses the preview task, sets it, and has it update its preview (the cursor's verdict among it).

name: esv::sight::ViewshedSystem::ProcessViewsheds

name: esv::sight::ViewshedSystem::UpdateViewshedParticipants
evidence: GK.Memory hardware watch on ViewshedParticipantComponent.CanSee (+0x10) of a goblin in TestLevel_Tom: the writes when it left and re-entered the host's sight came from HashTable Remove/Ensure called at +0x2E5E784 and +0x2E5E73B of this function, itself called from +0x2E53BAC under SystemUpdate<esv::sight::ViewshedSystem>; the decompiled body adds and removes ViewshedParticipantComponent and raises ViewshedParticipantsAddedEventOneFrameComponent
does: Keeps, on every entity in a viewshed, the set of observers whose sight holds it: adds the participant component, inserts and removes observers in its CanSee set, removes the component when nobody holds it.

name: esv::roll::stream::RollManager::GetDialogStream
evidence: the return chain of the CreateStream hit at +0x309FD9E on the first dialogue check passes +0x309F5E9; read in decomp code: looks up a stream of type 1 (Dialog) with the player's id at +0x4C, else creates one

name: esv::roll::stream::RollManager::CreateStream
evidence: GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's +0x18 (the last stream id) over the first dialogue check: one change 1->2 written at +0x309FD9E, and the new Dialog stream read seed = base seed + 2 with id 2 (Generic: id 1, seed base+1); same shape as EoCServer.dll esv::roll::stream::RollManager::CreateStream
does: Adds a roll stream of a type to the roll manager: the manager's last stream id plus one becomes the stream's id, the base seed plus that id its seed, its count zero; sets the manager's HasChanges.

name: ApplyHealthChange
evidence: GK.Memory.Watch on a goblin's eoc::HealthComponent.Hp (+0x0) during a fair melee hit for 7 on 2 hit points: the write of 0 came from bg3_dx11.exe+0x31C2DAE in the ECS frame of the damage, return address inside esv::StatsSystem::ThrowDamageEvent (+0x31C34A5); Health.Hp read 0 after
does: Takes the target's eoc::HealthComponent and writes the new hit points from the change it is given, clamped at 0; called by the damage event of the stats system

name: esv::RollSystem::RollDice
evidence: GK.Memory.Watch on a new passive check's eoc::RequestedRollComponent, armed in the tick the request appeared: its NaturalRoll (+0x42) written at +0x3296664 and +0x4C written at +0x3296682 (1 on a pass: natural 13 total over DC 10; read 0 on a fail: total 12 against DC 99), and its Result written through +0xF1889D from +0x32961CE; return chain into SystemUpdate<esv::RollSystem> (+0x2390BAC) via +0x32937EF, +0x32981CF; the decompiler's weak pairing with the Toolkit's esv::RollSystem::RollDice
does: Rolls one requested roll on the server: gets the roller's stream (the Dialog stream of a player for a dialogue check), copies the rolled result into the request, decides the verdict - a natural 20 succeeds, a natural 1 fails, else success when the difficulty is at most the total - and writes the natural die, the discarded die (only when advantage and disadvantage differ) and the verdict into the request.

name: esv::roll::stream::SaveSystem::SaveStreams
evidence: The watch on the component's NumRolls hit inside the stream copy with a return chain +0x105D985, +0x342DDF9, SystemUpdate<esv::roll::stream::SaveSystem> (+0x23993CC); the component's BaseSeed (+0x18), read with GK.Memory.Read, equals the Unix time of the load in seconds (tests/rolls/save/load.lua)
does: The SaveSystem's update: makes the roll streams component when there is none, its BaseSeed the time in seconds, and copies the roll manager's streams and last frame into it when the manager has changes, clearing that flag.
